data.revised_prompt: Create a stylized concept sheet for an Android app mascot named Mofei: one original floating AI mascot, centered full figure, horizontal oval translucent liquid-glass cockpit silhouette with a 1.25:1 ratio. The shell is frosted cool-white and ice-blue glass with pearlescent edges, internal refraction, volumetric light, and subtle soft shadow. The face is a deep-ocean-blue recessed rounded-square visor with no mouth, and two widely spaced vertical luminous eyes. Add two short transparent mechanical side brackets, and a thin lower orbital light ring. No arms, no legs, no base. Show clear status-color language through the visor edge, eye aura, orbital ring, inner glow, and soft shadow, with seven distinct states represented as elegant abstract color accents/swatch glows around the mascot: ice-blue idle, cyan-blue focus, violet confirmation, amber reminder, orange deadline, coral-red urgent, mint-white completion. Premium restrained intelligent assistant feel with gentle playful feedback; liquid glass, internal refraction, pearlescent glass edges, volumetric light; avoid plastic, chrome, vinyl. Composition: clean pale blue-white studio background, centered mascot, small surrounding arc of seven abstract colored light swatches, no text, no logo, no watermark, no human, no scenery.
